source_pr_title: Don't override container command by default
author: codacy-production
body:
<sub>:white_circle: LOW RISK</sub>

Suggestion: Ensure the command is only added to the manifest if it contains elements, preventing accidental overrides with an empty array.

```suggestion
          ...(values.command?.length ? { command: values.command } : {}),
```
